category: 天文學及航天科學/Astronomy and Space Science
questionText:
地球和木星環繞太陽的軌道可視為同一平面上的圓形，半徑分別為 $1.0\ \text{AU}$ 和 $5.2\ \text{AU}$。以下哪個可能是某時刻地球與木星之間的距離？
The orbits of the Earth and Jupiter around the Sun can be taken as circles in the same plane, of radii $1.0\ \text{AU}$ and $5.2\ \text{AU}$ respectively. Which of the following could be the distance between the Earth and Jupiter at some instant?

category: 天文學及航天科學/Astronomy and Space Science
questionText:
一個球狀星團可視為半徑 $50$ 光年的球體，內有約 $1.0\times10^{6}$ 顆恆星，均勻分佈。估算星團內相鄰恆星之間的典型距離。
A globular cluster can be treated as a sphere of radius $50$ light-years containing about $1.0\times10^{6}$ stars, uniformly distributed. Estimate the typical distance between neighbouring stars in the cluster.

category: 天文學及航天科學/Astronomy and Space Science
questionText:
香港位於北緯 $22.3^{\circ}$。下圖是香港觀測者的天球示意圖。在 12 月的冬至日正午，太陽（赤緯 $-23.4^{\circ}$）的地平高度和方向是怎樣的？
Hong Kong is at latitude $22.3^{\circ}$ N. The figure shows the celestial sphere for an observer in Hong Kong. At noon on the December solstice, what are the altitude and direction of the Sun (declination $-23.4^{\circ}$)?

category: 天文學及航天科學/Astronomy and Space Science
questionText:
某恆星光譜中一條在實驗室波長為 $500.00\ \text{nm}$ 的譜線，觀測得的波長為 $499.40\ \text{nm}$。這恆星沿視線方向的速度是多少？同一恆星另一條實驗室波長為 $600.00\ \text{nm}$ 的譜線，觀測得的波長是多少？
A line with a laboratory wavelength of $500.00\ \text{nm}$ in the spectrum of a star is observed at $499.40\ \text{nm}$. What is the velocity of the star along the line of sight? At what wavelength is another line of the same star, with a laboratory wavelength of $600.00\ \text{nm}$, observed?

options.A:
$360\ \text{km s}^{-1}$，遠離地球；$600.72\ \text{nm}$
$360\ \text{km s}^{-1}$, away from the Earth; $600.72\ \text{nm}$
options.B:
$360\ \text{km s}^{-1}$，接近地球；$599.28\ \text{nm}$
$360\ \text{km s}^{-1}$, towards the Earth; $599.28\ \text{nm}$
options.C:
$360\ \text{km s}^{-1}$，接近地球；$599.40\ \text{nm}$
$360\ \text{km s}^{-1}$, towards the Earth; $599.40\ \text{nm}$
options.D:
$720\ \text{km s}^{-1}$，接近地球；$598.56\ \text{nm}$
$720\ \text{km s}^{-1}$, towards the Earth; $598.56\ \text{nm}$

category: 天文學及航天科學/Astronomy and Space Science
questionText:
下圖（俯視，未按比例）顯示金星在環繞太陽的軌道上的四個位置 1、2、3、4。從地球上用望遠鏡觀測，金星在哪個位置會呈現細小的蛾眉月形，而且看起來最大？
The figure (top view, not to scale) shows four positions 1, 2, 3 and 4 of Venus in its orbit around the Sun. Observed from the Earth through a telescope, at which position does Venus appear as a thin crescent and look largest?

category: 天文學及航天科學/Astronomy and Space Science
questionText:
在一個沒有大氣的行星上空、離行星中心 $r$ 處，三個探測器 X、Y、Z 以相同方向（與連到行星中心的半徑垂直）分別獲得速率 $\sqrt{\dfrac{GM}{r}}$、$1.2\sqrt{\dfrac{GM}{r}}$ 和 $\sqrt{\dfrac{2GM}{r}}$，其中 $M$ 為行星質量。以下哪項正確描述它們其後的運動？
At a distance $r$ from the centre of an airless planet, three probes X, Y and Z are given speeds $\sqrt{\dfrac{GM}{r}}$, $1.2\sqrt{\dfrac{GM}{r}}$ and $\sqrt{\dfrac{2GM}{r}}$ respectively, all in the same direction perpendicular to the line joining them to the centre of the planet, where $M$ is the mass of the planet. Which of the following correctly describes their subsequent motion?

options.A:
X：圓形軌道；Y：起點為最近點的橢圓軌道；Z：逃離行星
X: circular orbit; Y: elliptical orbit with the starting point nearest to the planet; Z: escapes
options.B:
X：圓形軌道；Y：逃離行星；Z：逃離行星
X: circular orbit; Y: escapes; Z: escapes
options.C:
X：落向行星；Y：圓形軌道；Z：橢圓軌道
X: falls towards the planet; Y: circular orbit; Z: elliptical orbit
options.D:
X：圓形軌道；Y：起點為最遠點的橢圓軌道；Z：逃離行星
X: circular orbit; Y: elliptical orbit with the starting point farthest from the planet; Z: escapes

The figure shows the distribution of radiation intensity with wavelength for star X. Estimate the surface temperature of X from the figure.

questionText:
下圖是赫羅圖（H–R 圖）的一部分，標示了兩顆恆星 P 和 Q 的位置。Q 的半徑與 P 的半徑之比 $\dfrac{R_Q}{R_P}$ 是多少？
The figure is part of a Hertzsprung–Russell (H–R) diagram showing the positions of two stars P and Q. What is the ratio $\dfrac{R_Q}{R_P}$ of the radius of Q to that of P?
